scene: Holding the delicate bluebird, you step outside to three departing transit docks.
picture: Flat side view along the canal transit dock. Far left, a yellow flying scooter floats by a post. Left-centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit holds her glass bird, dog beside her. Right, a red double-decker hover bus hovers. Far right, an open gate leads directly into a gleaming silver hover metro.
shown: a sleek yellow flying scooter parked on the dock at the far left
a red double-decker hover bus idling at the curb on the right
